notesStmt.note: As Whitman's note at the top implies, this leaf was used as printer's copy for November Boughs. Horace Traubel reports that he delivered "the copy for Sands at Seventy" (the section of poetry) on June 1, 1888, so the present manuscript must have been created sometime before that date but after the poem's publication in the Herald on February 27, 1888. (See Traubel, With Walt Whitman in Camden, 1:242)

The clipping here is taken from the first publication of this poem in the 27 February 1888 issue of the New York Herald. The poem was subsequently included in November Boughs (1888) and later printings of Leaves of Grass, where it appeared alongside an earlier, longer poem with the same title.
